parent_objective: design guarded repair route using M2298 offtrack targets and collision guardrails
blocked_by: M2300 synthesis continues to guarded repair design and requires new measurable evidence quickly
supersedes: direct broad reward repair before synthesis

public_gates: M2301 must not run reset or rollout
M2301 must not train or run PPO
M2301 must preserve P0 actor input contract
M2301 must use M2298 offtrack targets as repair objectives
M2301 must use M2298 collision guardrails as non-regression constraints
M2301 must freeze a non-ranking implementation route for the next milestone
M2301 must not rank profiles, select a winner, or claim paper/self-ID evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use profile_name or profile_seed as repair targets
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns accepted target/guardrail synthesis into a bounded repair design with explicit acceptance gates
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no rollout training ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2298 repair_gate_spec is missing
stop if no repair route can reduce offtrack without collision guardrail risk
stop if the design needs profile-axis targets
stop if the next milestone would be another process-only step instead of implementation or data
fallback_plan: route to scenario-task reshaping if repair gates are contradictory
route to artifact-only target refinement if target slices are too broad
route to implementation manifest if a guarded repair route is clean
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2300 synthesis continued to guarded repair design

training_stage.stage_objective: design guarded repair route without executing it
admission_evidence: M2298 profile_target_slice_count and profile_guardrail_slice_count are zero
allowed_updates: M2301 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up implementation manifest selected by design
next_stage_criteria: guarded repair route is accepted or rejected
target and guardrail acceptance gates are frozen
next non-ranking implementation route is pre-registered

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2301 designs task-performance repair and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2301.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Treat guarded repair design as task-performance infrastructure, not self-ID evidence.

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: defines how future repair evidence must be judged against target/guardrail slices
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit a bounded repair implementation but cannot improve the verdict by itself
must_synthesize_if: M2301 cannot define a clean implementation route
M2301 only restates M2298 gates without an actionable repair design

hypothesis: A guarded repair design can convert M2298 offtrack targets and collision guardrails into a bounded non-ranking repair route without changing actor inputs or scenario specs.
success_criteria: M2301 freezes offtrack target improvement gates from M2298
M2301 freezes collision guardrail non-regression gates from M2298
M2301 names allowed repair knobs and blocked shortcuts
M2301 pre-registers one non-ranking follow-up implementation route
failure_criteria: M2301 changes actor inputs or scenario specs
M2301 uses profile_name/profile_seed as repair targets
M2301 ranks profiles or selects a winner
M2301 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2301 cannot select a next route

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual design over M2298 target/guardrail artifacts and repair_gate_spec.json

decision_rule: M2301 passes if it freezes a bounded guarded repair implementation route without training or ranking.
